description: This file contains benchmark tests for various Bloom filter implementations and their usage with GrainId objects, including setup, benchmark methods, and auxiliary classes for calculating false positive rates. It also defines custom benchmark configurations.

classes.name: FalsePositiveRateColumnAttribute
classes.description: Custom attribute class for configuring a BenchmarkDotNet column to display false positive rate

classes.name: OriginalBloomFilter
classes.description: A simple Bloom filter implementation using bit arrays and multiple hash functions

classes.name: BloomFilter
classes.description: A more sophisticated Bloom filter implementation with dynamic sizing and multiple hash functions, including mixing and bit-setting/clearing methods.

methods.name: GlobalSetup
methods.description: Initializes data structures and sample data for benchmarking

methods.description: Checks sample elements for presence in the BloomFilter

methods.name: BloomFilter_FPR
methods.description: Calculates false positive rate for the BloomFilter with samples
